newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Jardine raises 1.8 bln pesos new equity.
newsitem.headline: Jardine raises 1.8 bln pesos new equity.

text.p: Philippine diversified firm Jardine Davies Inc said on Tuesday it raised 1.87 billion pesos in new capital to finance its participation in various projects.
In a press statement, Jardine said the bulk of the new equity will come from Jardine Matheson and the balance from existing minority shareholders.

Among its projects are the 2.3 billion peso development of middle income housing in partnership with Hongkong Land, San Miguel Properties, Equitable Bank and Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co and the 500 million peso upgrading of its sugar milling subsidiary, Hawaiian Philippine Co.

The company said it also supports the increase in cement production of Republic Cement Corp where it has a 27 percent equity stake. Republic will require 2.8 billion pesos to increase its production from 500,000 to 1.5 million tonnes.
Jardine said MB Finance, a company where it bought a 40 percent stake last year, is also upgrading its operations to meet demand for consumer finance.
